title: Compliance Ledger Generator — scheduled snapshot bundles with templated PDFs and CSVs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers in regulated industries need a simple, auditable way to receive periodic evidence packages (PDF + CSV) showing data residency, retention enforcement, and access logs for a given tenant and time window. Current exports are ad-hoc, require manual aggregation across logs and dashboards, and do not produce templated legal-ready PDFs or grouped bundles that satisfy auditors.

Goal: Build a Compliance Ledger Generator that can be scheduled per-tenant to produce immutable snapshot bundles (zip) containing: a templated PDF summary, one or more CSVs (events, retention actions, residency assignments), and a metadata manifest. Bundles are residency-aware (data for EU tenants routed to EU storage), support incremental deltas, and can be pushed to tenant S3 endpoints or emailed to configured addresses.

Scope: MVP will support scheduled daily/weekly/monthly snapshots, PDF templating with company header/footer and signature block, CSV schemas for events/retention, tenant-level residency routing, and a dashboard page to view/export history and delivery status. Out of scope for MVP: on-prem delivery adapters (will be tracked separately), multi-tenant coalesced bundles, and encrypted notarization (future epics).
acceptance_criteria: Admin can configure per-tenant schedule (daily/weekly/monthly) and delivery targets (S3/email).
Generated bundle contains: one PDF summary (templated), events.csv, retention_actions.csv, residency_manifest.json (manifest file name allowed), and a checksum file.
Bundles for EU-resident tenants are stored in EU buckets and flagged with EU_RESIDENCY in metadata.
Dashboard shows last 90 days of generated bundles with status (success/failure/queued) and links to download.
Export job retries with backoff on transient failures and surfaces permanent failures as incidents in Console alerts.
Product test: create tenant with mixed-region data, run scheduled job, verify residency routing and content correctness using provided prompt sets and sample events.
Security review signoff obtained and KMS key usage documented in runbook.

implementation_notes: Batching: reuse existing export worker framework (ENG-8122) but add residency-aware storage adapter. For large tenants enable incremental delta to avoid re-exporting full event history. PDF generation will use server-side templating (weave-based) and must include an export_id and immutable timestamp. Each bundle will be signed with a KMS-managed HMAC and checksum file included. Delivery: S3 uploads should validate bucket policy and region; email delivery uses pre-signed download links that expire after configurable TTL.
qa_plan: Create test tenants with sample events spanning regions. Tests: full bundle generation, incremental export, residency routing, failure and retry behaviors, manifest validation, PDF rendering accuracy, and download URL expiry. Add e2e nightly job to validate sample tenant bundles against a golden manifest. QA to verify legal footer content and signature presence.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature flag behind tenant opt-in; 2) Soft launch with internal compliance tenants and two pilot customers; 3) Monitor success rates and latency metrics for 2 weeks; 4) Gradual enablement for more customers with targeted comms and runbook. Update docs and on-call playbooks prior to broad enablement.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Large tenants produce huge bundles causing worker OOMs. Mitigation: stream CSVs to object storage instead of in-memory zipping; add per-tenant chunking.
Risk: Residency misrouting due to misconfigured tenant metadata. Mitigation: add pre-flight residency check and a dry-run mode that surfaces misconfigurations before delivery.
Risk: Legal changes to PDF content late in cycle. Mitigation: template variables and versioning to avoid large code changes for copy updates.
follow_ups: Add on-prem delivery adapter (tracked as PM-7401).
Implement encrypted notarization service for high-assurance bundles (future epic).
Enhance retention action detail granularity for audit use-cases (ENG-8340).
